author: Cheryl Bush
text: Yes, this happens on occasion. You can call the freestyle customer service. They will ask you for your sensor information, which can be found in the app. They will ship you out a new one, which will take three to five business days to arrive. They will also send you packaging to send back the defective sensor. The ones they send me are always FedEx returns, which personally I find to be kind of a pain, but whatever.
